LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonCraterInspectStalled: Regrowth stalled: the lunar network is not supplying hemogel.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonCraterFlowBarTooltip:
Hemogel drawn from the lunar network to heal the wound and regrow the umbilicus.
Range: {0}–{1} per hour. Requested: {2} per hour. Received: {3} per hour.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonCraterFormedLetterText:
The moon-side root of the celestial umbilicus has been destroyed, cutting off the passage to the surface.
An open wound remains where the root stood. Supply hemogel from the lunar network to regrow the umbilicus; select the wound to set its draw rate.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonCraterRegrownLetterText: The wound has healed around a new root. The celestial umbilicus has regrown, linking the flesh moon to the surface once more.
